notes.title: Hexels 2.56 Update - Effects Galore!
notes.content:
With this update we shine the spotlight on our fantastic Effects library. Hexels 2.56 makes it easy to import effects, improves our document recovery system, and fixes a number of miscellaneous bugs!

The real star of the show is the new guide that demonstrates how you can use our effects to an add an extra layer of awesome to your paintings. Create blizzards with the Snow shader, elevate the atmosphere with the Thermal Distortion shader and take full control of the lighting in your isometric wonderlands using the Normal Map Lighting shader. Fringe your pixels with a fancy Chromatic Aberration shader and give a nod to the good old days of pixel art with the Dither blend mode.

Get started by downloading the effects: https://www.marmoset.co/posts/hexels-effects/

Are you well versed in the magical arts of engineering? The custom shader tutorial is for you: https://www.marmoset.co/posts/custom-shaders-in-hexels-2/

View the full version history here: https://www.marmoset.co/hexels/history/

notes.title: Hexels 2.04 Update
notes.content:
Hello people of Hexlandia! This update is all about minor bugs, special characters and some data loss within Timeline. The most important bug we’ve fixed involves missing icons for some users and a bug where deleting a selection and hitting undo causes problems. 

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed missing icon issues
    [*]Fixed data loss bug when deleting a selection
    [*]Fixed crash with files containing special characters
    [*]Fixed bugs with the frame count text box
[/list]

notes.title: Hexels 2.03 Update
notes.content:
This Valentine's, we’ve wined, dined, and refined Hexels 2. The 2.03 update brings a few fixes for crashes, a failure to install (on Steam), and resolves a bug causing data loss. The complete list of changes is listed below!

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Shift-click 'Add Next Key Cel' to add a blank key cel
[*]Improved Hexels-to-Trixels conversion
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed crash bug on Mac when file names contain special characters
[*]Fixed data loss bug caused when deleting a selection
[*]Fixed bugs with the frame count text box
[*]Fixed possible crash with custom shape and image layers
[*]Shape mode-specific scripts will only run in the proper shape mode
[*]Added better support for foreign characters
[*]Fixed various issues with Super Grid
[*]Fixed issue where the Custom Shape preview didn’t always update
[*]Fixed stray outlines in classic mode when Wrapped Canvas and Hafltone are enabled
[*]Timeline should no longer encroach on the main window
[*]Fixed bug with loading image layers
[*]Improved onion skinning when halftone mode is turned on
[*]Gradient and noise tools are now affected by Super Grid
[*]Sub-divide scripts now retain zoom level and saves previous shape-type to the Super Grid when converting from Hexels (or an old Trixels document)
[/list]

notes.title: Hexels 2.02 Update
notes.content:
Hexels 2 is now available on Steam! Hexels is a fun, intuitive painting app that allows you to effortlessly tap into your creative side. Hexels 2 brings new features such as animation, layers, refined painting tools, new shape modes, a sharp, customizable interface, and much more.

The 2.02 update resolves a number of issues, including a crash on launch problem on Windows, and a crash when adding a new image layer. We’ve also added a script to sub-divide a Pixel canvas with the 2.02 update.

For a full breakdown of new features and bug fixes, read below. Enjoy!

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Sub-divide Pixels script
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed crash on launch (Windows)
[*]Fixed crash when adding image layer
[*]Onion Skinning now works in Pixel Mode
[*]Frame border hidden in export preview
[*]Improvements to animation playback in preview window
[*]Improvements to Trixel SVG output
[*]Fixed Outline errors with 1.2 files
[/list]
